subject: Re: CAIQ: walkthrough scenarios & exemplar artifacts
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lodestar.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security.team@lodestar.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: walkthrough scenarios & exemplar artifacts

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick run-through last week. As we prepare for our CSA review, the audit team asked if you can provide a short "scenario matrix" that maps a handful of common customer workflows to the CAIQ controls (so we can show control coverage end-to-end). They also want 2–3 example artifacts (redacted logs, config screenshots, policy snippets) that demonstrate the control in practice.

High level ask: can Redwood supply a short playbook (1–2 pages) describing the scenario mapping and a small bundle of exemplar artifacts we can include in our submission? If possible, we'd like to receive this by end of next week.

Little context: Lodestar will scope their CSA to public cloud + managed inference. They're especially interested in controls around key management, tenant isolation, telemetry, and change control.

Appreciate your help — can we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough to talk through the matrix?

Best,
Alex Chen
Security Program Manager
Lodestar Health

--
Attachment: lodestar_scope_summary.pdf (stub, PDF)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lodestar.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: walkthrough scenarios & exemplar artifacts

Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely provide a concise scenario matrix and a short bundle of example artifacts. I've attached a first-draft playbook (caiq_scenario_playbook_v0.1.pdf) and an initial matrix (caiq_scenario_matrix_v1.xlsx) that maps 6 representative customer scenarios to the CAIQ controls you called out.

Summary of what I attached: 
- Playbook (PDF): one-page walkthrough pattern + guidance on redaction and what to include in Lodestar's submission.
- Matrix (xlsx): rows are scenarios (ingest+inference, multi-tenant routing, key rotation, model rollout, telemetry ingestion, incident triage) and columns are CAIQ control IDs with a short "how we meet it" note.

Requested next steps: 
1) Kimberly — can you confirm if we should include a sanitized sample of KV cache access logs or a configuration snapshot for tenant routing? 
2) Marissa — if we hand off 2 artifacts (e.g., key rotation log excerpt and a trimmed telemetry trace), can you own the redaction?
3) Alex — I propose a 30-minute walkthrough Thursday 6/11 at 10:00 PT to walk the matrix line-by-line and finalize which artifacts we deliver. Does that work for your team?

We typically aim to bundle artifacts as: 1) policy + config screenshot, 2) redacted runtime logs (timestamped), 3) attestation note or change request record. The playbook includes a suggested redaction checklist.

Sincerely,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: caiq_scenario_playbook_v0.1.pdf (stub, PDF)
Attachment: caiq_scenario_matrix_v1.xlsx (stub, Spreadsheet)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@lodestar.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: walkthrough scenarios & exemplar artifacts

Soojin / Alex —

Quick note: I'm happy to take the artifact redaction. Recommendation based on the scenarios in the matrix: include a sanitized key-rotation audit (showing rotation events and user ids truncated), and a 30-second telemetry trace that demonstrates request routing and tenant id separation.

I'll draft a short guidance file for redaction and link the final artifacts to the Drive folder. Marissa — can you confirm retention-safe copies exist for those two samples? If not, I'll work with infra to pull a timeboxed dump.

Kimberly
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: artifact-sample-guidance.md (stub, Plain text)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lodestar.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security.team@lodestar.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: walkthrough scenarios & exemplar artifacts

Soojin / Kimberly / Marissa —

Perfect, this is exactly what we needed. Thursday 6/11 10:00 PT works for the walkthrough; calendar invite sent (please accept). As discussed, we'll take the key-rotation excerpt and the short telemetry trace as the two artifacts. We'll rely on your redaction guidance and will point auditors to the scenario matrix during the session.

A couple of follow-ups for the walkthrough: 
- Can you include a short note in the playbook explaining the fallback model routing behavior (we want to confirm automatic fallback policies in high-load scenarios).
- For the key rotation artifact, auditors usually want the rotation cadence + the KMS key identifier (we expect you to redact full key ids).

Thanks again — looking forward to the session.

Best regards,
Alex Chen
Security Program Manager, Lodestar Health

--
